#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore the newline after the integer input
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    // Replace all underscores with spaces
    for (char &c : s) {
        if (c == '_') {
            c = ' ';
        }
    }

    // Insert spaces around parentheses
    std::string processed;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '(') {
            processed += " ( ";
        } else if (c == ')') {
            processed += " ) ";
        } else {
            processed += c;
        }
    }

    // Split the string into tokens
    std::istringstream iss(processed);
    std::string token;
    int maxLen = 0;
    int count = 0;
    bool inParentheses = false;

    while (iss >> token) {
        if (token.find('(') != std::string::npos) {
            inParentheses = true;
        } else if (token.find(')') != std::string::npos) {
            inParentheses = false;
        } else if (token.find('(') == std::string::npos && token.find(')') == std::string::npos) {
            if (inParentheses) {
                count++;
            } else {
                maxLen = std::max(maxLen, static_cast<int>(token.length()));
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxLen << " " << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
